After Italo Calvino, Le città invisibili (1972). The descriptions here are brief paraphrases written for this atlas; read the book itself.

Some cities answer to the viewer. Look up at Zemrude, then down. Watch Moriana turn. Approach Penthesilea and see where its center goes.

Le città invisibili

Invisible Cities

Marco Polo describes to Kublai Khan the cities of an empire too vast to be seen. Fifty five of them, in nine chapters and eleven themes, rebuilt here as small models on a lagoon at dusk.

Laying the foundations

drag to orbit, scroll to approach, click a city to visit it
